Built **The Long Peel** in `index.html` as a complete, responsive incremental game.

Click or press **Space** to peel potatoes, then spend your earnings on tools and helpers that automate peeling. Lifetime sentence progress stays intact when you buy upgrades. The game saves locally, includes up to 8 hours of offline progress, and shows a release screen at one million potatoes.

Assumption: since the project had no existing app, I made this a self-contained browser game. Verified the script parses and checked the game in desktop and mobile browser views, including peeling and buying an upgrade.
